instructions.mission: Create comprehensive story context for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}
instructions.constraints: - Do NOT perform web searches or web fetches. All needed context is in the provided artifacts. - Do NOT run shell commands (git log, etc.). Work only from the provided files. - Focus on synthesis from existing artifacts, not research.

steps.step: The target story is already determined from the sprint status queue. Epic: {epic_num}, Story: {story_num}, Key: {story_key}

From the provided project artifacts, extract: - Story scope and requirements from the epic file - Architectural guardrails, design patterns, and stack from the architecture document - Any relevant UX or PRD context (if provided) - If story_num > 1, check for prior story files in implementation artifacts to understand what was already built

Create the story file using the template. Fill in: - User story statement (As a... I want... So that...) - Acceptance criteria derived from the epic's story definition - Tasks and subtasks mapped to acceptance criteria - Dev notes: architecture patterns, constraints, file structure, dependencies - Testing approach (what to test, not the detailed checklist — that comes later)
Mark the story as "ready-for-dev" in sprint-status.yaml. Update the story key {story_key} status from "backlog" to "ready-for-dev".
